newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO CONSTRUCTION UP 1.06 PCT IN FIRST HALF '97.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO CONSTRUCTION UP 1.06 PCT IN FIRST HALF '97.

text.p: Construction activity in Mexico rose 1.06 percent during the first half of the year compared to the same period a year earlier, the Chamber of Industry and Construction (CMIC) said on Thursday.
"In the first half, the value of production was 23.065 billion pesos, with growth of 1.06 percent compared to the same period a year earlier," the Chamber said in a statement.
The chamber noted that the formal construction sector had begun its recuperation, but noted the sector was still "fragile."
The Chamber noted that public sector activity, which makes up 66.09 percent of the total, rose 13.89 percent in the first half over the same period a year earlier.

The 1.06 percent rise in the first six months of the year was about half of the increase seen in the first six months of 1994, the Chamber added. The first half 1994 was before the crash of the peso and a sharp decline in economic activity in Mexico.
